mapper.sql: s.id, s.product_id, s.seckill_price, s.stock, s.sold_count, s.per_user_limit, s.start_at, s.end_at, s.status, s.created_at, s.updated_at
, p.name AS product_name, p.type AS product_type, p.price AS product_price
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO seckill_activity (product_id, seckill_price, stock, sold_count, per_user_limit, start_at, end_at, status) VALUES (#{productId}, #{seckillPrice}, #{stock}, #{soldCount}, #{perUserLimit}, #{startAt}, #{endAt}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE seckill_activity SET seckill_price = #{seckillPrice}, stock = #{stock}, per_user_limit = #{perUserLimit}, start_at = #{startAt}, end_at = #{endAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'DRAFT'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM seckill_activity s JOIN product p ON p.id = s.product_id WHERE s.id = #{id}

SELECT FROM seckill_activity s JOIN product p ON p.id = s.product_id WHERE s.product_id = #{productId} AND s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND s.start_at <= NOW(3) AND s.end_at > NOW(3) ORDER BY s.id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE seckill_activity SET status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'DRAFT'
UPDATE seckill_activity SET status = 'CANCELLED' WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('DRAFT', 'ACTIVE')
UPDATE seckill_activity SET status = 'ENDED' WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE seckill_activity SET sold_count = sold_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND start_at <= NOW(3) AND end_at > NOW(3) AND stock - sold_count >= 1
UPDATE seckill_activity SET sold_count = sold_count - 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND sold_count > 0
mapper.select: SELECT FROM seckill_activity s JOIN product p ON p.id = s.product_id WHERE s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND s.end_at > NOW(3)
